useCases.title: Run the Claude Agent SDK on any model
useCases.summary: Point query() at AnyRouter, no SDK fork
useCases.problem: The Agent SDK is built for Anthropic's /messages API. Teams still want GPT, GLM, Llama, or a failover preset without rewriting the loop.

snippets.title: query()

steps: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://anyrouter.dev/api and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to your sk-ar key.
Pass model: "anyrouter/auto" (or any catalog id) in query() options.
